passage:
Space exploration has greatly expanded human understanding of the universe. Since the first moon landing in 1969, scientists have continued to study planets, stars, and galaxies through advanced telescopes and spacecraft missions. Space agencies around the world invest billions of dollars each year in scientific research and technological development.

One important benefit of space exploration is the advancement of technology. Many inventions originally created for space missions are now used in daily life, including satellite communication systems, medical equipment, and weather forecasting technology. In addition, studying other planets may help scientists better understand Earth’s climate and environmental systems.

However, space exploration also presents challenges. Missions are extremely expensive and often involve significant risks for astronauts. Some people argue that governments should focus more on solving problems on Earth rather than spending large amounts of money on space programs. Despite these concerns, many scientists believe that space exploration will continue to provide valuable discoveries for humanity.
